answer: Yes, you can sell a car with Virginia registration at a North Carolina store, but there are two things to sort out first. North Carolina is the exception to the expired-registration rule: the registration must be current on the day of the sale, so renew your Virginia registration before your appointment and bring the registration card Virginia issued. North Carolina stores also need an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before they can buy a car registered in another state. Because your plates are from Virginia, take them off and keep them.
